title: An Edge-Based Formulation for the Exact Computation of High-Order Zernike Moments of 2D Shapes and Images
summary: Zernike moments are widely used rotation-invariant descriptors for shape and image analysis, but their standard computation relies on a pixel-based quadrature that treats each pixel as a point mass located at its center. This approximation introduces spatial aliasing that increases with moment order, degrading image reconstruction and reducing the discriminative power of high-order moments.
